fact: The World Bank says the first project designed and implemented the Unified Social Registry (RSU), which serves as the single entry point for new social programmes; the registry and RNP enrolled about half the population.
source_slug: 2024-12-04 World Bank approves $70M for Morocco's social protection delivery (RNP and Unified Social Registry)

fact: The World Bank project description says it supports the implementation of the Unified Social Registry (RSU) as a unique gateway for all social safety net programmes, including in rural and remote areas.
The author says the Registre social unifié processes social and economic data to calculate an index used in targeting beneficiaries of social programmes.
The author says the Registre social unifié index is used in targeting beneficiaries of social programmes (plural, unnamed).

The Head of Government's department says 5.3 million families were enrolled in the Registre Social Unifie as of mid-September 2025, and 1.8 million RSU families received a supplementary school-year aid.

The RSU information system registers households through automated checking against more than 30 administrative databases, and held 4.1 million households (40% of the population) at 31 December 2023, per the Ministry of Interior document.
The Ministry of Interior document says the RSU is used to improve targeting of social protection programmes (plural) and that the RNP is used by social protection programmes.
